notes: Vaulty answers in general now — not just from the Vault's database. Farm questions work in every phrasing ('where would be the best place to farm X', 'where does X drop', 'how can I get X'): the natural best-place wording used to hit the don't-know card, and that failure is fixed at the root. If the Vault's data doesn't have a factual answer, Vaulty no longer hands you research buttons — he researches it himself, automatically: live game data, the Warframe Wiki's drop info, Wikipedia — and answers with the real farm spot and a citation. And with the AI downloaded, a question neither the Vault nor research covers gets a general-knowledge answer clearly labeled 'From my general knowledge (not Vault data)': Vault data, Researched, and General knowledge are three separate labels, never blurred. Builds still come only from the verified engine.
